name: Otegaru Bishoujo! -Rena Hen-
source:
I have a girlfriend I'm proud of. She's so popular that some people said she has been dating with many guys. Even though I have always been close to her, I have never been able to be proactive in such matter.
"Hmm, okay, I don't mind giving you the privilege to date me. Kufufu."
So, when I heard those words, I was so happy I feel as if I soared in the sky.

We go home together everyday and we also spend lunch breaks together. Rena always smiles to me and I have been very happy.
"Kufu, for the next break, I guess I shall barge into your room......"
When I heard Rena so saying, my heart skipped a beat.
"Huh? Barge into my room?" Since the exam is just around the corner, maybe we'll have a study session together, I guess. Wait, have I cleaned up my room properly?

2 base HCGs + some variations + full voice
